sloka: धर्मदारान् परित्यज्य परदारान्नि षेवताम् ।त्यक्तधर्मरतिर्मूढो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-५३॥
transliteration: dharmadārān parityajya paradārānni ṣevatām ।tyaktadharmaratirmūḍho yasyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-53॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a foolish person who abandons righteous conduct and forsakes his rightfully married wife and resorts to other man's wife acquires
